public_sources.purpose: fresh upstream stage authority, capability persistence, sandbox and runtime handoff

actions: verified fresh upstream Argus main and rechecked authority/sandbox source
traced RepairCapability nonce persistence and host handoff
traced Manager/daemon pipeline lock around normal route and stage operations
searched public Argus code/history/issues for a stage-capability migration
compared independent public host-admission and stale-authority patterns
persisted a scope-corrected candidate refinement and nonempty frontier
material_findings: RepairCapability nonce is omitted from model prompt/runner kwargs but persisted plaintext in Manager control state; default and ordinary workspace-write layouts do not establish universal read secrecy.
Normal Manager route commits and daemon supervisor/stage work are serialized by the same outer pipeline lock, so the earlier normal-path route/stage TOCTOU suspicion is narrowed/retracted.

Fresh upstream still lacks a mutator-bound stage capability; low-level stage primitives remain caller-unauthenticated, so clean-os-g1-005 is refined toward host-only opaque capability plus exact state-revision CAS while retaining the outer lock.
exact_next_action: Sweep every fresh-upstream production stage/route mutator call site for outer-lock coverage versus real bypass paths, then build a three-layout Manager-secret readability matrix and search an independent agent runtime that binds opaque host authority to an exact durable-state revision.
